column1: # Accepted CodeQL findings. The gate in production-checks.yml ignores exactly
# these, and nothing else. Changing this file takes a pull request.

column3: CSRF is handled without tokens: every non-GET /api request passes requireSameOrigin (Origin/Referer must equal this host; a browser always sends Origin on cross-origin POST/PUT), the session cookie is SameSite=Lax, and state-changing endpoints only accept JSON bodies (cross-site JSON needs a CORS preflight, which is never granted). CodeQL does not recognise the Origin check. Tested in test/api.test.ts (requireSameOrigin) and test/settingsRoutes.test.ts (cross-site PUT settings, POST reboot, PUT preferences all get 403 and reach nothing).

Two cases, both deliberate (cam-proxy spec 2026-10-05 §12.3). pinnedConnection(): a camera on the leaf-pin fallback serves its self-signed factory certificate, so the chain cannot verify; the socket is opened with rejectUnauthorized false and the SHA-256 of the leaf is compared with the pin at secureConnect, before any request byte is written, and destroyed on a mismatch (Node skips checkServerIdentity when the chain fails, so that hook cannot carry the check). Tested in test/cameraTls.test.ts ("pinned: sends nothing when the pin doesn’t match": zero bytes reach the server). tlsOptions() kind "none": an https camera without tlsServername and without a pinned proxy, unverified exactly as before this change (it was rejectUnauthorized: Boolean(tlsServername)); cams logs a warning at start for such a camera.

cameraCertificate() for a camera on the leaf-pin fallback: it only reads the served certificate for display (nothing is sent) and shows it only when its SHA-256 equals the pin, else "not available". Tested in test/cameraTrust.test.ts ("reads a pinned factory certificate, and nothing for another").
